clue.text: Reach end of session consumed by anger

explanation.surface: A meeting finishes in a burst of temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'end of session' gives N, taken in by RAGE.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms as nouns: the reach of something is its extent or scope.

clue.text: Fixing coupling overlooked by engineers

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps

explanation.surface: Mending a link that engineers missed.

explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: mending something broken is fixing it.

clue.text: Relative from city on the Med being reported

indicators.note: being reported means the city's name is said aloud

parts.note: Nice is a city on the French Mediterranean coast

explanation.surface: Family news from the French Riviera.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a brother's or sister's daughter is a relative.

clue.text: Smart worker supports the French on the rise, for example

in a down answer rising means the letters read upwards

an ant is a worker insect

explanation.surface: A labourer props up the French, who are on the up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the rise' turns LE into EL.

clue.text: Fish that's pale and a bit off

indicators.note: food that is off has gone bad, so these letters are spoilt into a new order

explanation.surface: A fish that looks pallid and smells slightly bad.

clue.text: Exercises or makes solid connections across Italy

parts.note: to weld is to join metal solidly

clue.text: No one gets over following sick American fantasy

parts.note: sick means ill
US means American

clue.text: Make amends for former buccaneer ignoring queen

clue.text: Takes works of Picasso, say

definitions.meaning: to take away or extract something is to abstract it

explanation.surface: Someone helps themself to Picasso's paintings.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a verb meaning removes or extracts, and a noun for non-figurative pictures.

clue.text: Feeling fatigue but bound to welcome runs

indicators.note: to welcome is to take in, so the bound word holds the letter

parts.note: bound means tied
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A weary cricketer still obliged to accept runs.

clue.text: Man needs grain that's ground periodically

parts.note: a man in chess or draughts is a playing piece

clue.text: Bill has no time for such an exhibitionist

indicators.note: the bill word lacks the letter, so it is removed

parts.note: a bill is a poster stuck on a wall

explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone who strikes attitudes to be noticed is a show-off posturing for attention.

clue.text: Country church estate on the west of Italy

indicators.note: in an across answer the west is the left, so this letter comes first

parts.note: I is the international vehicle code for Italy
CE is the Church of England
an estate is an area of land

explanation.surface: A rural church's grounds lie west of Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Nordic island nation in the North Atlantic is a country.

clue.text: Looked across river and took the lead

indicators.note: the looking word stretches across the letter, holding it inside

parts.note: looked fixedly means stared

explanation.surface: Someone gazed over a river and then went in front.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: an actor who took the lead role in a film had top billing in it.

clue.text: One source of neglect in French house fire

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: the first letter of neglect is placed inside the French house

parts.note: a gîte is a French holiday cottage

indicators.note: the source of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A neglected French cottage burns down.
explanation.walkthrough: N goes inside GITE after its G, then I comes in front.

clue.text: First officer's best-seller?

the top record in the charts

explanation.surface: A ship's second-in-command writes a hit book.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a navy title for the executive officer, and a chart-topping record.

clue.text: Generation gap sees gang returning in sulk

indicators.note: the reversed gang sits inside the sulk word

parts.note: a crew is a gang of workers

explanation.definitionFit: Pun: a gap in the generating of electricity is an outage of the mains supply.

clue.text: Routine part of tyre on motorway — outwardly lethal

parts.note: the tread is the part of a tyre that grips the road
the M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway, written MI

indicators.note: outwardly means the outside letters of lethal

explanation.surface: A worn tyre on the motorway is fatal.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a dull repetitive routine is likened to a mill trodden endlessly.

clue.text: Pass, slip, and fall down

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass
a lapse is a slip

explanation.surface: A climber crosses a pass, slips and tumbles.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to cave in or fall down suddenly is to crumple.

clue.text: Awful shame appearing in short robe for programme

short means the robe word loses its last letter

parts.note: a gown is a robe

indicators.note: awful means the letters of shame are mangled into a new order

clue.text: Fixes up favourite for scrap

indicators.note: in a down answer up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: pins fixes in place
a pet is a favourite

explanation.surface: Someone repairs their pet's toy for scrap.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a small fragment or scrap of something.

clue.text: Timid type eating second sweet

indicators.note: the timid creature eats, taking the letter inside

parts.note: a mouse is a byword for a timid person

explanation.surface: A shy person helps themself to a second dessert.

clue.text: Start shortly with lines to generate more business

indicators.note: shortly means the start word is cut by its last letter

parts.note: the outset is the start

explanation.surface: Quickly launching new product lines boosts trade.
explanation.definitionFit: Paraphrase: to beat a rival in sales is to generate more business than they do.

clue.text: Fish rest regularly, finding cover

parts.note: a carp is a fish

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter of rest is taken

explanation.surface: Fish resting now and then find shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: Function: a rug or floor covering is a cover for the floor.

clue.text: Remarkable postscript about the Spanish being infiltrated by US agency

indicators.note: about means the postscript letters turn round
the agency gets inside the other letters, as spies infiltrate

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
the CIA is the US Central Intelligence Agency

explanation.surface: A spy agency sneaks into a Spanish letter's footnote.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns PS into SP; with EL that gives SPEL, which CIA enters.

clue.text: Sense good deal

definitions.meaning: vision is one of the five senses
a ... more means a good deal more, informally

explanation.surface: Seeing a bargain.

clue.text: Settler needing help to protect new queen maybe on the way back

clue.text: Friend may be appearing during call

indicators.note: the appearing word comes during the call, inside it

parts.note: a cry is a call
a performer appearing on stage is on

explanation.surface: A friend might drop in mid-phone call.

clue.text: Band involved in aggro, upset

indicators.note: the letters are wrapped up within these words

explanation.surface: A rock band gets caught up in violent trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a band of musicians is a pop group.

clue.text: Sausage one must have seasoning on to start with

parts.note: pepper is a seasoning
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A sausage that needs spices first.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a spicy salami is a kind of sausage, popular on pizza.

clue.text: This may require one to be patient

definitions.text: This may require one to be patient

parts.words: This may require one to be patient
parts.note: patient here is the noun, a person under medical care, not the adjective for waiting calmly

explanation.surface: Something that calls for patience.

clue.text: Patriotic prince perhaps initially changing sides

explanation.surface: A prince who defects at the start is hardly a patriot.
